name: AffordHunt

sources.title: AffordHunt submit page - returned empty body (JS-rendered)
Launch Point Zero profile citing submit URL https://www.affordhunt.com/submit
NavifyAI profile: paid submission (~$199, or $99 fast-track with code), 30-60 day review
LaunchPedia: 'directory of affordable alternatives to popular AI and SaaS tools... 1000 best tools, vetted by humans'
AffordHunt Product Hunt page - launched Aug 2023, curated platform for budget-friendly tool alternatives

requirements: Positioning: a curated directory of AFFORDABLE alternatives to popular AI/SaaS tools — the product should be pitched as a budget-friendly competitor to a known tool
Site is JS-rendered — both homepage and /submit return empty bodies to plain fetchers
Third-party sources report a submission fee around $199 with a ~$99 'premium/fast-track' option via discount code, and a 30-60 day review window (fast-track ~1 week)
Copy angle expected: 'share how you are better when compared to your competitor'
preparation: Product URL, name, and a comparison pitch naming the expensive incumbent you undercut
Clear low pricing — affordability is the directory's premise
Payment for the submission fee (figure unverified on first-party page)
A browser — the site cannot be driven by static HTML fetches
workflow: Complete the submission form, positioning the product as an affordable alternative to a named tool
Pay the submission fee and wait through the stated review window (30-60 days per third-party sources)
Verify the listing appears in the tools index
watchFor: Conflicting fee reports ($199 vs $99-with-code vs 'fast-track $99') — read the live submit page before paying
Positioning trap: the directory is specifically about CHEAP alternatives — a premium-priced product does not fit the premise
Site renders nothing without JavaScript — cannot be audited statically
Third-party copy suggests the same operator runs a 'submit to 150+ directories' service — the submission may funnel into a paid distribution service rather than a simple listing
countsAsLive: The product appears as a card in the AffordHunt tools directory
unknowns: Exact form fields and current fee (page is JS-rendered)
Whether the listing link is dofollow (catalog note says follow; unconfirmed)
